correctness.rationale: For each selected rook vertex (i,j) the induced degree is d_i+e_j-2; equality/opposition of row and column parities therefore characterizes even/odd degrees. Each binary incidence matrix has unique parity-class sets, leaving two disjoint admissible rectangles with prescribed mod-two margins. The sign-character projection proves B_ab even for zero-sized sides. The two-row dichotomy between one full column and only single cells gives the displayed closed forms, including the empty set in both. I independently enumerated actual graph induced degrees for boards (1,1),(1,3),(2,1..5),(3,3),(3,4) and matched the polynomial/structural predictions; the general theorem is symbolic, not inferred from these tests.
